_comment: Stub bodies for preview.py. Key = the /api path your UI calls, value = the JSON it should get back. Paths match like runtime.api_routes does: exact key first, then the longest '/prefix/*'. A value may be an envelope -- {"status": 500}, {"delay_ms": 1500, "body": {...}}, {"body": []} -- so that 'could not load', 'still loading' and 'nothing here yet' are all photographable. Copy the shapes from your own route handlers; anything unlisted answers {}. The entries below serve templates/v2-starter; the last three are examples for your own list/detail screens.

/api/notes.text: A note that came back from the stub, so the form renders with real content.

/api/items/*.title: First item
/api/items/*.subtitle: from the stub
/api/items/*.note: This is what the detail screen gets. Without prefix matching it would be {}.
